constraints: Preserve original metadata/definition lookups, loop sorting and node_order appends.
Buffer the exact existing one-entry JSONB object per iteration; this preserves keys, values, JSON nulls and immediate SQL NULL-key refusal.
Coalesce empty aggregation to an empty JSONB object; order duplicate-key aggregation by captured iteration ordinality to preserve last-wins semantics.
Keep full operation preparation, final graph/forest/multiplicity checks, authority checks, limits and deadlines unchanged.
performance_qualification: None. This removes repeated growing-map concatenation at one source hotspot; the original1000-node/1000-edge workload remains unqualified until an actual complete pass.
rationale: Neither initial node loop nor initial edge loop reads its accumulated map; the boundary loop reads neither. Materialization can occur immediately after each producer loop.
Node keys remain stored:+entry.key; edge keys remain derived relationship type/id. The two keys are not interchangeable.
Invocation-local arrays contain state only; there is no persistent state, actor cache, public API or helper change.
verification_plan: Existing meaningful owned/edge workflows, then the unchanged original1000-node/1000-edge matrix after the coordinated CPU window. No unit-pass performance claim.
